successCriteria.description: Create src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exporting LeaveRequestStatus enum with values DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED

Create LeaveType interface with fields: id (string), code (string), name (string), description (string), isPaid (boolean), requiresDocumentation (boolean), isActive (boolean), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date)

Create LeavePolicy interface with fields from reconciled architecture: id, policyName, leaveTypeId, entitlementDays, accrualRate, maxAccumulation, minimumNoticeDays, maximumConsecutiveDays, requiresManagerApproval, allowNegativeBalance, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt

Create LeaveRequest interface with fields: id, employeeId, leaveTypeId, startDate, endDate, reason, status (LeaveRequestStatus), approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason, createdAt, updatedAt
Create CreateLeaveRequestDto type (omits id, status, approval/rejection/cancellation tracking fields, timestamps)
Create UpdateLeaveRequestStatusDto type with status, actorId, and conditional fields (rejectionReason for REJECTED, cancellationReason for CANCELLED)

Create src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts with ILeaveRequestRepository interface extending IBaseRepository<LeaveRequest> and declaring findOverlapping(employeeId, startDate, endDate, excludeId?) method
Create KnexLeaveRepository class extending BaseKnexRepository<LeaveRequest>, accepting knex + tableName in constructor, implementing findOverlapping via Knex query builder with overlap logic

Create tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.repository.test.ts with Jest unit tests covering findById, findAll, create, update, delete, and findOverlapping (including overlap detection and exclusion of a given request ID)

constraints: LeavePolicy fields must use the reconciled architecture names: maxAccumulation (not maxCarryoverDays), minimumNoticeDays (not minRequestDays), plus requiresManagerApproval and allowNegativeBalance which are present in the canonical spec but absent from the intent text
Repository interface must be named ILeaveRequestRepository (canonical from reconciled architecture), not ILeaveRepository as stated in the intent text
KnexLeaveRepository must extend BaseKnexRepository<LeaveRequest> from src/shared/base.repository.ts, accepting knex: Knex and tableName: string via constructor
Table name for leave requests must be leave_requests (snake_case per SQL schema)
All database access must go through the repository layer (GP-001); no inline SQL in models or tests
Tests must use Jest and mock Knex instance; no real database connection in unit tests
No any types — use unknown with type guards where needed (HARNESS.json constraint no-any)
outOfScope: Database migrations for leave_requests, leave_types, leave_policies tables (Phase 6)
Repositories for LeaveType, LeavePolicy, Balance, Employee, Audit — these belong to their respective modules (policy, balance, employee, audit)
State-transition validation logic (belongs in service layer, Phase 3)
RBAC enforcement, audit logging, balance deduction/restoration — orchestration concerns deferred to service layer (Phase 3+)

ambiguities.description: The exact overlap detection logic for findOverlapping is not fully specified — should it use strict inequality (startDate < existing.endDate AND endDate > existing.startDate) or inclusive? Should it filter by status (only SUBMITTED and APPROVED per BR-002) or return all overlapping requests?
options: Use standard half-open interval: startDate < existing.endDate AND endDate > existing.startDate, filtered to SUBMITTED and APPROVED statuses per BR-002
Use inclusive overlap: startDate <= existing.endDate AND endDate >= existing.startDate, no status filter
Return all overlapping rows unfiltered; let the service layer apply BR-002 filtering
